polarization: TM retained from Figure2; experimental fiber polarization unspecified
optical_parameters: same linear-interpolated n,k and hole/layer geometry as Figure2
generation: full III-V absorbed-photon density, including doped InGaAs contacts; actual collection is solved by SDevice. Not restricted to the 250-nm absorber.
source_power_normalization: use native incident photon flux times photon energy for each oblique-incidence case; no fitted responsivity multiplier
assumptions: 2D slots, effective grading index and layer/fill assumptions retained; finite 20x20 3D hole array not represented
incidence_assumption: Experiment reports 10-degree tilt but no azimuth relative to the chosen section.
